visualParity.$description: Live-vs-clone per-section parity for the two product routes (R12), captured with extraction/parity_capture.mjs and scored with extraction/parity_compare.py. Same viewport (W x 900) and same section-relative scroll offset on both sides (arrive by wheel-scrolling, section top corrected to 20px below the viewport top, sections taller than the viewport captured in 900px slices), fonts and images awaited, prefers-reduced-motion on both sides. Values per section: pixel = share of unmasked pixels whose max RGB channel diff <= 32 (the gate, >= 80% per section); ink = the same counted only where either side differs from the section background (stricter diagnostic, not the gate); masked = share of the section area excluded as truly dynamic.
masks: eyebrow braille spinner glyphs (80ms frame cycle)
hero chat thread + prompt bar (typing loop keeps running on the live page even under reduced motion)
CTA wave shader / its PNG fallback layer
XI Sources dotLottie canvas / Lottie container
solutions marquee rows (40.6px/s, phase depends on load time)
visualParity.notMasked: hero rays shader (both sides render one fixed frame under reduced motion), XI/RI step-card illustrations and the RI A3 Sources loop (time-based on the live page; compared as captured)
visualParity.consentBanner: the live cookie-consent banner is runtime UI outside every section; it was hidden in the capture (never clicked)

inkBelow80.note: Diagnostic only (the gate passes everywhere).
